hypotheses: Asked to set iaso up for Codex or Hermes, iaso writes only that host's adapter: Codex's AGENTS block and hooks, Hermes's plugin and namespaced skills, each with the /iaso command where the host has one and its session marker where it can be set. Installing twice changes nothing, the owner's own entries are kept, uninstalling removes only iaso's, and status reports what is installed without claiming it is active. Each adapter binds events to the project it was installed in, ignores child sessions, gives the brief once, sends a block at most once, and records a summary that never reached the owner as unseen. The Pi adapter and the MCP server stay removed; the Codex and Hermes adapters are kept and not frozen (they may come back into use later, and nothing of them is removed).
given an AGENTS.md with the owner's own text, when iaso's Codex adapter is installed twice, then the owner's text is unchanged and one iaso block exists
given iaso's Codex adapter installed, when it is uninstalled, then only iaso's entries are removed
given a repository, when iaso's Codex adapter is installed, then nothing of Claude Code's or Hermes's is written: no .claude settings, no Hermes plugin

given the adapter not loaded (Hermes with project plugins off, Codex with a foreign shell_environment_policy kept), when iaso's status for that host is asked, then it says the session marker is missing on this host, where the owner's prompts come from, and how many approvals rest on a self-recorded message
given the Hermes plugin files and discovery flag exist, when iaso's status for Hermes is asked, then installed files and prerequisites are reported while runtime activation remains unverified
given Hermes skills installed for a project, when the agent resolves a iaso skill, then only the iaso-qualified name resolves, and uninstalling the Hermes adapter removes those skill files
given iaso installed for Codex or Hermes, when iaso installs there, then iaso's Claude Code band is not installed; that host gets only its own things
given the rendered Hermes plugin and a fake ctx, when register(ctx) runs, then a iaso command is registered and each registered hook returns turn output lines

given a Hermes ctx without hook registration, when register(ctx) runs, then only the command is registered, no error is raised, and the instruction block tells the agent to run iaso turn start and iaso turn end
given the generated Hermes plugin belongs to repo A and the process runs in repo B, when a prompt callback runs, then only repo A receives the hook payload
given the generated plugin root lacks .iaso, when any event callback runs, then no subprocess is launched and empty adapter output is returned
given an observer may fire before session ancestry is known, when the first eligible parent prompt arrives, then one brief is obtained after filtering, and later prompts do not duplicate it
given parent_session_id is explicit, when prompt and later callbacks run, then no owner prompt or summary events are emitted for the child
given a child observer fires without parent metadata, when later callbacks identify its parent session, then no startup or other subprocess event is emitted

given another transform wins or a reply is interrupted, when the turn settles, then the summary is recorded as unseen, so the records it named are not marked as shown and are given to the agent again on the next turn
